desc: Brazier spirit: small dark violet iron brazier body with a red crystal flame on top. Face: two fierce angry slanted red glowing eyes and a jagged little mouth. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
